items.title: Reflection AI releases Beam, a 501B open-weight MoE under Apache 2.0
items.summary: Reflection AI published the weights for Beam on Hugging Face on Oct 16, after unveiling it earlier in the month. It is a sparse mixture-of-experts model with 501B total and 23B active parameters, aimed at coding and agentic work, with a 1M-token context.
items.whyItMatters: A permissively licensed US open-weight model is a possible self-hosted backend for the tutor's text reasoning, though it isn't a voice model and is aimed at coding.
